title: Decaying Airship in Void
description: A surreal, heavily decayed hot air balloon with a skull-like face dominates the scene, its envelope riddled with holes and dripping viscous fluid. A small metallic UFO hovers nearby, illuminated by a single beam of light against a backdrop of massive, porous, crumbling organic structures.
prompt: A surreal dark scene featuring a massive decaying hot air balloon shaped like a rotting skull with empty eye sockets, its torn surface covered in holes and dripping viscous fluid. A small metallic flying saucer hovers beside it, lit by a dramatic beam of light from above. The balloon is surrounded by towering, porous, bone-like organic rock formations that are also riddled with holes and decay, all set against a pitch black void.
